The actual route file src/app/(focused)/onboarding/page.tsx renders ONLY `<CreatorOnboarding />` (src/components/onboarding/CreatorOnboarding.tsx) — a tier-pick-and-pay subscription flow that never imports useSession/session-provider.tsx and never calls setAccountType or setInterests. Those two functions are real, but are called from a different screen entirely: src/app/(auth)/sign-up/components/SignUpFlow.tsx (scan-map id 'auth-flows'), which is out of my scope for this fragment. This fragment therefore documents the code actually reachable at the /onboarding route (CreatorOnboarding.tsx + src/lib/api/subscription.ts + src/lib/api/mocks/session.ts), not the account-type/interests picker the scan-map entry describes. This is the same real component covered by scan-map's separate 'creator-onboarding-subscription-signup' entry — the two scan-map entries appear to describe the same physical screen with different (and partially incorrect) framing.
